## Targets (ChEMBL / Open Targets) 
SLC6A4 
## Indications (Open Targets) 
 
Depressive disorder, Obsessive-compulsive disorder, Panic disorder, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Premenstrual dysphoric disorder, Social phobia, postpartum depression (Phase 3), tic disorder (Phase 2), cocaine dependence (Phase 2), Huntington disease (Phase 1), attempted suicide (Phase 2/3), burning mouth syndrome (Phase 3)
